tool_args.rationale: Flux saturates with input and falls as the gradient increases. A sum of saturating terms with one gradient-gated contribution gives a training RMSE of about 0.00042; the largest leave-one-out error is about 0.0074. All paid rows are at H=0.6, so the model is submitted for fresh confirmation at that horizon.

considered_alternatives.option: Gradient-independent Beverton–Holt recruitment or bilinear mass action
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Neither explains the gradient dependence, and the bilinear law also misses saturation.

considered_alternatives.option: Single saturating flux with a multiplicative gradient gate
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Its training RMSE was about 0.098, above the 0.045 target.
Both relevant probes have already been acquired. The fitted model is stable under leave-one-out checks, so fresh confirmation is more informative than another training measurement.
